heading: Wednesday Night
text: Clear to partly cloudy. Patchy valley fog late. Lows in the upper 20s to lower 30s, except mid to upper 30s in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys. Winds becoming light and variable, except south 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Thursday
text: Patchy valley fog early, then partly to mostly sunny. Highs from the mid 50s to lower 60s. Winds variable to southwest at around 5 mph east of the Greens, from the south to southwest 5 to 10 mph in areas west of the Greens, except gusting to 20 mph in the St. Lawrence Valley.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Variable clouds. Lows mainly in the mid to upper 30s, with some lower 30s in the cold spots, and upper 30s to mid 40s in the broad valleys west. South to southwest winds decreasing to 5 mph or less, except 5 to 10 mph and gusting to 15 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.
